headline: Prime Minister Announces Changes to Housing Loan Rules: Who Will Pay Lower Interest
summary: The government wants to tie the interest rate under the eOselia housing loan programme to the number of children in a family. Prime Minister announced changes to the housing loan rules.
why: State-subsidised mortgage programmes affect housing demand, construction activity and banks' mortgage lending in Ukraine.
